{{Top|leg}}
A '''homing transponder''' was a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] that emitted a signal that could be picked up by [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] tuned to receive it. A portable [[directional transceiver]] received the signal, and could lead an individual to the source of the signal. The [[F7V Valet/Translator Droid]] [[KL-6TLF7V/T]] was fitted with a homing transponder as part of his service as an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent.<ref name="TA">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>

Homing transponders were also a part of the [[Repulsor throwing razor/Legends|repulsor throwing razor's]] retrieval system. The wielder wore the homing transponder on their belt, coded to the owner's genetic pattern. When activated, it triggered the [[repulsorlift motor]] in the weapon's blade and returned it to the owner.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
